W8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
A held-out line still shares lineage, culture and screening batch with the training
lines. W6 bounds the transcriptome's contribution, not the batch's.
Gene effect is a growth phenotype integrated over weeks; nothing here speaks to the
immediate consequence of a knockout.
The PROFILE arms cannot be applied to an unseen gene at all -- a gene IS an output
unit -- so W5 speaks only for the PAIR arms.
Four CPU threads and a fixed epoch budget. A negative W3 is a statement about what
these architectures reach here, not a proof that no network can beat a linear model.
